reason: The cited evidence (E1) discusses the efficiency of CPA and MTP methods for different properties but provides no specific support for any of the key premises regarding ML-based prediction of lattice thermal conductivity, decoupling of contributions, or the role of local atomic fluctuations in HfNbTaTiZr.
premises: ML-augmented atomistic simulation can independently predict lattice thermal conductivity
